structural_incompleteness_classification.description: Classification of known mathematical incompleteness into structural and operational categories.

classifications.basis: Intrinsic information loss in non-local CSI membership; causal history cannot be uniquely reconstructed.
Stability at exact zero is a singular limit; handle via explicit boundary-condition hypothesis.
Stability over unbounded iterations lacks a finite symbolic proof; treat as asymptotic assumption.
Multi-branch retention is a formal requirement (RC-026); unique selection is not asserted.
Formal CSI metric is currently a simulation-parameter placeholder; removable via geometric formalization.
Participation space requires formal measure definition to resolve discrete projection fragilities.
Branching is a core process dynamic; incompleteness in unique continuation is a preserved feature.
Mapping from observables to preimages is inherently multi-valued for dissipative operators.
